constraints.expression: profile != 'a2a-agent-card' || (a2a != null && directory == null && vc == null)
constraints.message: profile 'a2a-agent-card' requires the a2a block and forbids the directory and vc blocks.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated. The TS reference enforces AIB-1 at validate() time via the validateAgentIdentityBinding cross-field validator; the published JSON Schema encodes the same rule as an if/then clause in its root allOf, and the DSL expression restates it for constraint-file consumers.

constraints.expression: profile != 'directory-identity' || (directory != null && a2a == null && vc == null)
constraints.message: profile 'directory-identity' requires the directory block and forbids the a2a and vc blocks.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated. The TS reference enforces AIB-2 at validate() time via the validateAgentIdentityBinding cross-field validator; the published JSON Schema encodes the same rule as an if/then clause in its root allOf, and the DSL expression restates it for constraint-file consumers.

constraints.expression: profile != 'verifiable-credential' || (vc != null && a2a == null && directory == null)
constraints.message: profile 'verifiable-credential' requires the vc block and forbids the a2a and directory blocks.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated. The TS reference enforces AIB-3 at validate() time via the validateAgentIdentityBinding cross-field validator; the published JSON Schema encodes the same rule as an if/then clause in its root allOf, and the DSL expression restates it for constraint-file consumers.

constraints.expression: consumer verifies the ed25519 signature by bound_by_signer_id over the JCS-canonical binding with the signature field omitted when signature is present, and verifies a2a.card_signature_jws over the JCS-canonical Agent Card when present
constraints.message: AgentIdentityBinding carries signatures but the library does NOT verify them. Consumers verify both signature and a2a.card_signature_jws before treating the binding as authoritative.
constraints.evaluation_note: Crypto verification is consumer-side per ADR-010; obligation reason: crypto_deferred. The schema is deliberately NOT marked x-crypto-bearing because signature is optional and the flag cannot be conditional on field presence, so validate() does not require acceptDeferred for this schema. Consumers MUST treat a present signature or card_signature_jws as unverified until their own verifier has checked it against the key referenced by bound_by_signer_id (for signature) or the key material published for the card (for card_signature_jws). The library also does not fetch card_url or recompute card_hash (AIB-N1).

constraints.expression: consumer resolves agent_id to an AgentIdentity and confirms bound_by_signer_id is authorized to bind identities for that agent
constraints.message: agent_id resolution and binder authority are consumer authority. The library checks shape only.
constraints.evaluation_note: Consumer authority per ADR-010. Resolving agent_id requires an agent registry and authorizing bound_by_signer_id requires the consumer's keyring and competence rules; neither is available to a single-record validator. The library does not validate directory.accountable_role against any directory (AIB-N2) and does not enforce one binding per agent across records (AIB-N4).
